Live Firestore round-trip for Driver-class fields (esp. Garaj printer MAC + Depozit) on a real device/account -- confirm the ref.listen(DriverProvider)/ref.listen(LocalStoreProvider) dual-listener path converges correctly in practice, not just by code trace. Also: driver edits made with poor/no connectivity save locally but the Firestore leg is fire-and-forget (silent on failure) -- confirm this is acceptable offline behavior or flag for a 'pending sync' indicator

New ANGAJAT dimension resolution on transfers: do a real transfer submission with a real driver account on-device, confirm the transfer lands in BC with the CORRECT ANGAJAT dimension code (cross-check against BC's dimensionValues), and confirm a driver whose name genuinely doesn't resolve (or the DUMITRASCU/LUCIAN ambiguous case specifically, if that's a real active driver) sees a clear refusal message and the transfer does NOT post to BC
